name: alertcheck-monorepo
description: AlertCheck - Free-tier, offline-capable critical-information integrity checker for emergency warnings

scripts.build: npm run --workspace=@alertcheck/verification-core build && npm run --workspace=@alertcheck/backend build && npm run --workspace=@alertcheck/frontend build
scripts.test: npm run --workspace=@alertcheck/verification-core test && npm run --workspace=@alertcheck/backend test && npm run --workspace=@alertcheck/frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace=@alertcheck/verification-core typecheck && npm run --workspace=@alertcheck/backend typecheck && npm run --workspace=@alertcheck/frontend typecheck

author: AlertCheck Team
